reason: Each FR-06 requirement maps to a load-bearing assertion: R1 (service/api must not hold Session) → tests/test_fr06.py:767; R2 (transaction() CM commits on clean exit, rolls back on exception) → tests/test_fr06.py:295 (rollback visible==0) and tests/test_fr06.py:307 (commit visible==1), plus CM source string checks at tests/test_fr06.py:641 ('commit') and tests/test_fr06.py:648 ('rollback'), plus repository-uses-CM spy check at tests/test_fr06.py:709; R3 (no string SQL concat) → tests/test_fr06.py:422 (f-string SELECT hits==0) and tests/test_fr06.py:435 (% format hits==0); R4 (no N+1: selectinload/joinedload) → tests/test_fr06.py:584 (statement_log <= 3 across seed_count=50); R5 (pool_size=TASKQ_DB_POOL_SIZE, pool_pre_ping=True) → tests/test_fr06.py:807 (pool_size) and tests/test_fr06.py:819 (pre_ping is True).

gaps.message: test_pool_config_uses_settings skips the pool_size assertion when the engine uses StaticPool/NullPool (SQLite testing path: pool_size_attr is None → pass-through); the pool_size half of AC-6.5 may not be validated in SQLite runs. The pre_ping half is always asserted at line 819.
